x_query.oql:
works where year >= (2005)
  and year <= (2025)
  and title/abstract has (
    (
      RPAS or UAS or UAV or UAVs or stemmed "remotely piloted aircraft"
      or stemmed "unmanned aerial" or stemmed "unmanned aircraft" or drone
      or drones
    )
    and (
      stemmed "air pollution" or stemmed "air quality"
      or stemmed "environmental monitoring" or stemmed "greenhouse gas"
      or stemmed "nature conservation" or stemmed "protected area"
      or stemmed "water quality" or biodiversity or coastal or ecological
      or ecology or ecosystem or ecosystems or forest or forests or habitat
      or habitats or marine or methane or vegetation or wetland or wetlands
      or wildfire or wildlife
    )
  )
  and type is (article or review)
sample 100 seed 20260826
